description: Source code implementing HKDF (HMAC-based Extract-and-Expand Key Derivation Function) functions, including HKDF, HKDF_extract, and HKDF_expand, using OpenSSL libraries.

methods.name: HKDF
methods.description: Performs HKDF key derivation using extract and expand steps.

methods.name: HKDF_extract
methods.description: Performs the extract step of HKDF, producing a pseudorandom key from input keying material.

methods.name: HKDF_expand
methods.description: Performs the expand step of HKDF, generating output key material of desired length.
